english.title: Trespass on an aerodrome
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) trespassed on land forming part of an aerodrome, namely **(..SPECIFY AERODROME..) licensed in pursuance of an Air Navigation Order or authorised by a certificate under the Aerodromes Regulation
english.legislation: Contrary to section 39(1) of the Civil Aviation Act 1982.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
trespass

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: The offence will not apply unless it is proved that, at the material time, notices warning trespassers of their liability under this section were posted so as to be readily seen and read by members of the public, in such positions on or near the boundary of the aerodrome as appear to the court to be proper (see section 39(2)).
